title: On the category of semi-graded modules
summary: Lezama \cite{LezamaLatorre2017} introduced the notion of semi-graded ring with the aim of generalizing $\mathbb{Z}$-graded rings and several families of noncommutative rings of polynomial type non-$\mathbb{N}$-graded such as the skew Poincaré-Birkhoff-Witt extensions defined by him \cite{GallegoLezama2010}. In a series of papers, \cite{Lezama2020, Lezama2021, LezamaGomez2019, LezamaLatorre2017}, he studied problems of non-commutative projective algebraic geometry generalizing the original ideas of Artin et al. \cite{Artin1992, ArtinSchelter1987, ArtinTateVandenBergh2007,…
